title: Admin Concierge: task templater and helper utilities for operator workflows
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Build an "admin concierge" tooling layer that turns human-readable runbooks into parameterized, auditable task templates operators can execute or hand off. The goal is to reduce cognitive overhead during oncall and support escalations by providing: (1) a templater that compiles markdown-style runbook steps into a typed task graph; (2) role- and context-aware gating (who can execute a step, required approvals); (3) dry-run and simulation modes for QA; (4) automatic telemetry / audit events sent to our observability pipeline; and (5) helper utilities (credential-safe shortcuts, preflight checks, idempotency keys) for common ops patterns. This ticket focuses on the templater + execution shim and the first-class operator UX in the Console to run, review, and rollback task runs.
acceptance_criteria: Templater compiles at least 3 canonical runbook formats (markdown steps, YAML step lists, legacy CSV) into a unified task graph JSON schema
Execution shim can run graph steps in serial and parallel, capturing step-level logs and producing audit events to our logging pipeline
RBAC checks enforced: steps tagged 'privileged' require two approvals or a specific operator role
Dry-run mode validates permissions and simulates API calls without side effects
Console surface shows run history, step outputs, and rollback button for reversible steps

estimated_savings: 18% mean time to resolve for applicable incidents
implementation_decisions: Use a small typed task graph JSON schema rather than an embedded DSL to simplify validation and cross-team consumption
Audit events will be emitted as structured logs to the existing ops-events topic — allows replay and alerting
Credential helper will mint short-lived credentials and persist only idempotency keys in DB; secrets never stored in task graph
followups: Enable automatic conversion CLI to migrate legacy Confluence runbooks (follow-up ticket)
Metric: measure operator time spent per run vs manual baseline (observability dashboard tile)
Policy: define retention for dry-run logs and simulation artifacts
